name: creditos
description: CreditOS — AI Credit Repair Operating System (monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @creditos/api" "npm run dev -w @creditos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @creditos/api && npm run build -w @creditos/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @creditos/api && npm run lint -w @creditos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @creditos/api && npm run typecheck -w @creditos/web
